episodes.synopsis: Surely Ataru wouldn’t misuse bubble gum that has the power to create whatever he wants. But would that be worse than Lum losing the ability to speak other languages?
episodes.title: Fantasy Balloon Gum / Love Knows No Barriers

episodes.synopsis: Ryunosuke grew up without a mother and wants to know more about her. Unfortunately, her father is keeping an important detail from her.
episodes.title: Trickle of Memories / Album of Memories / The Home Visit Blues: Feuding Fujinami Edition

episodes.synopsis: Lum has a new suitor, but it doesn’t take long before there’s trouble in paradise.
episodes.title: Electric Jungle

episodes.synopsis: Relationship drama swiftly follows when Kurama sets her eyes on Rei. Speaking of relationships, Mendo discovers that he’s engaged to Tobimaro’s sister.
episodes.title: Love Thief / That Mizunokoji Girl

episodes.synopsis: As Mendo desperately tries to escape his unwanted engagement, Asuka’s upbringing gives a whole new meaning to the term sheltered.
episodes.title: The Continuation of: That Mizunokoji Girl

episodes.synopsis: Life is full of unexpected events, like an extra lively kotatsu purchase and Lum believing she’s turning into a cow.
episodes.title: Kotatsu Love /  Lum Becomes a Cow / The Home Visit Blues: Luxurious Mendo Edition

episodes.synopsis: No good can come of Ataru and Ten switching bodies, nor using Lum’s shortcut to get to school on time.
episodes.title: Eerie Earmuffs / Family Tree

episodes.synopsis: Shinobu, Lum, and Ataru take an unexpected trip to the future. The good news is they discover who their spouses are. The bad news is their disappointment is immeasurable.
episodes.title: Open the Door (1)

episodes.synopsis: The trio are determined to find their ideal futures, but each one they find leave them unsatisfied. And Inaba’s coworkers are not happy with the group’s meddling.
episodes.title: Open the Door (2) / The Home Visit Blues: Prohibitive Miyake Edition

episodes.synopsis: Whether it’s an octopus or a girl burdened by regrets, spirits need assistance from the living. Unexpectedly, Mendo and Ataru find themselves navigating these burdens.
episodes.title: Haunted Mendo / Last Date

episodes.synopsis: Whodunit? No one saw what happened to the principal despite all of them being in the same room. Later, chaos ensues when flowers start spreading rumors around town.
episodes.title: The Case of the Battered Principal / The Secret Garden / The Home Visit Blues: Hellish Moroboshi Edition

episodes.synopsis: Lum finds herself in a race against time to save Ataru. Later, a certain fox seeks to recreate an old legend with magic horsetail shoots. Even later, Mark meets Lum's parents.
episodes.title: Lovely Darling in Danger!! / Foxes in the Moonlight / The Home Visit Blues: Mark Onsen Goes to Space

episodes.synopsis: What kind of training is Mendo doing, anyway? Lum and Ataru are going to find out.
episodes.title: Wretched Shutaro!!

episodes.synopsis: Asuka's mother hatches a plan to help her daughter overcome her fear of men. It appears that drastic measures are on the horizon.
episodes.title: Asuka Returns / A Stormy Date (1)

episodes.synopsis: Asuka and Mendo go on a date and to say things don’t go as planned would be a vast understatement.
episodes.title: A Stormy Date (2)

episodes.synopsis: Ryunosuke and her father are now the proud owners of a seaside cafe and an island after paying a suspiciously cheap price! Later, a fairy asks Ten to find his missing parasol.
episodes.title: Nagisa's Fiancé / The Fairy's Parasol

episodes.synopsis: Nagisa needs a kiss from Ryunosuke to pass on, which is easier said than done. Later, Mark threatens his class with supplementary lessons if he catches them talking.
episodes.title: One Night's Battle / Deadly Peril in the Classroom

episodes.synopsis: Inaba returns and has an important question for Shinobu.
episodes.title: Flower Petals of Love and Courage

episodes.synopsis: Ten must apologize for ruining Ataru’s scarf, but how? Later, candy hearts have the same effect as love potions. Meanwhile, the Dark Dominion lies on the horizon.
episodes.title: Lum's Wrath / Steal My Heart

episodes.synopsis: Lum is not happy when she learns she’s being forced into an arranged marriage thanks to her great grandfather.
episodes.title: Boy Meets Girl: The Morning of Farewell

episodes.synopsis: Ataru and Mendo team up with Lum’s friends to save her from a forced marriage. But they aren’t the only ones who’re trying to stop the wedding.
episodes.title: Boy Meets Girl: Are You Really Getting Married?

episodes.synopsis: What started as a misunderstanding ends in a falling out. Now Lum refuses to return until Ataru apologizes.
episodes.title: Boy Meets Girl: Crooked Heart

episodes.synopsis: With the fate of the Earth on the line again, Lum and Ataru’s last game of tag begins.
episodes.title: Boy Meets Girl: I Want You When I Can't Have You
